message.content: {"cases":[{"target_alias":"SRC_001","attack":true,"case":"The problem explicitly demands an execution test: 'Test the claim below by RUNNING it, and report what actually happened.' The target openly declines to do this — 'Prediction, not measurement: I cannot execute code here' — and instead asserts by construction what a hypothetical suite would produce. Every number it reports (fires 4/4, held 3/4) is a stipulated example, not an observed run, so the deliverable 'report the two counts side by side' from an actual experiment is unmet. Worse, its own arithmetic is not even the falsification the problem requires: it shows a constructed suite where G2 is redundant by design, then declares 'This supports the claim' — but nothing was run that could have surprised it, so no falsification was possible. It also omits the second design constraint's requirement to say which commitments would have to exist for (a) and (b) to come apart beyond the single G2/M3 case; a 'prediction' cannot test whether reported agreement tracks the same property.","counterexample":null,"premise":null,"premise_evidence":null}]}
